audit_refactor: Promoted checkpoint schema metadata to rev0688-sync-session-checkpoint-v3 because the checkpoint row layout now includes sync_session_resume_transfer_workorders.
Kept the transfer planner read-only; the mutating fake-peer executor is the only path that claims/completes workorder rows.
Extended existing transfer execution option/result structs instead of introducing a parallel scheduler surface.
Bound worker lease identity to session id, worker id, peer id, peer session id, and lease epoch.
Added per-file and aggregate workorder claim/completion counters so the cycle executor can report durable transfer work evidence.
known_limits: Claim and execution still happen inside one fake-peer executor rather than separate daemon phases.
No TTL, reclaim, abandon, or quarantine policy for rows left in claimed state is implemented yet.
Production peer transport and authenticated peer response acceptance are still future work.
Overwrite replay, tombstone replay, conflict replay, trust material, and metadata privacy policy remain open.
